step1_holdout_test.question: Does the banked prediction machine hold on a city NOT in the fit? (LOCO validation vs the banked 93.8% t+1 direction result)

drift_check_first.what: before any refit: banked fixed betas + CURRENT on-disk files, banked scorer replicated line-for-line
drift_check_first.result: FE-3_arc_tplus1 lag-1 dir = 0.938, n=16 — EXACT replication of the banked 0.938; the banked number is REPRODUCIBLE from the current files, not stale
drift_check_first.note: scoring the full drift-check pool (lags 1-3, n=36) gives 0.694 — all-lags pooling across the 2021-25 decline arc is a different (harder) test than the banked lag-1 headline; both carried

loco_refit_results.convention: betas re-derived on remaining cities (within-city standardized OLS); held-out city keeps its OWN descriptive moments; scored at lag-1 with the banked direction convention

plain_english: The t+1 MURDER-ARC direction survives being blotted out of its own training set: every one of the four held-out scores ran 0.75-1.00 (mean 0.812, min 0.75, all within-city rho +0.8 to +1.0), against banked 0.938 in-sample. The wide care+unemp lane scores even better out-of-fit (mean 0.887). The model's knowledge is not one city's memorized arc. What does NOT hold: (a) LEVEL transfer — feeding the held-out city with no own moments (strict-blind) drops St. Louis to 0.00 (its level sits ~30 rate-pts above the training pool); the machine is a within-city arc instrument, not a between-city level instrument; (b) the FE-2 cage/bookings instrument (mean 0.525 — coin-flip class). The expansion gate opens for ARC-class expansion.
honest_laws: form-B strict-blind reads are labeled as level-transfer reads, not failures of the arc instrument
Cincinnati/Detroit/Memphis/St.Louis have the complete FE-3 frame; NYC not in the FE-3_arc frame (honest frame note)
every refit n, beta and SE banked in _gauntlet1_loco.json

step2_residual_stick.question: Does the administration-lane residual predict itself next year? (does residual-2022 predict residual-2023?)
step2_residual_stick.verdict: STICKS (WEAK) — above the 0.3 direction-class threshold POOLED, at the threshold per-city; sign-holds on 1 of 4 city-year 2022->2023 tests

pooled.note: pairs are not independent (4-5 cities; a city-year enters twice) — no inference, direction-class read only

step2_residual_stick.plain_english: Pooled lag-1 r = 0.459 (rho 0.521, n=26 consecutive city-year pairs) — above the 0.3 bar: the budget-efficiency residual is NOT pure wind. But the split is honest: Cincinnati (12 consecutive years, r 0.431) and Detroit (r 0.930) carry the stickiness; the 2022->2023 literal sign-holds only in Memphis (+2.2 -> +10.2); Cincinnati (+1.4 -> -0.4), Detroit (+7.8 -> -0.4) and St. Louis (+6.3 -> -8.5) all flip. The instrument measures something durable over a multi-year arc (Detroit's over-predicted 2020-22 followed by under-predicted 2023-25 is a real run, not noise) but a single next-year read is coin-toss class. Use the administration instrument on FIRST-HALF/SECOND-HALF arcs (already the banked convention), never one-year-ahead.

step3_composition_bias.question: Would adding poorly-publishing cities plausibly flip any banked coefficient sign?
step3_composition_bias.verdict: HOLD (with named fragile columns) — the FOUNDER-CARRYING coefficients (care negative, snap positive, FE-6 pair) never flip under any drop-class; the fragile columns are the ones the model's verdict does not lean on

honest_null_cities.note: outcome-series carries 40 cities; panel carries 6. The 34 non-panel cities are the honest-null class: they could not enter ANY fit because care/cage $ books (city budget-dept grain) were never pulled for them — the selection is by input availability, not outcome availability.

step3_composition_bias.plain_english: Who would the poor publishers be? The banked classes: Jacksonville (ten straight 0/12 non-reporting years), Raleigh (5/12-months 2014, four-year silence after), Omaha/Fresno/Baltimore/Long Beach/Sacramento/Tucson/San Francisco/Phoenix/Pittsburgh (single-year month-guards), and 34 cities whose outcome cells exist but whose city budget-books were never pulled (selection is by INPUT availability, not outcome). When every low-quality row class is dropped (2025+ forecast-vintage rows; each city in turn), the care beta never flips sign in ANY of the 4 models' 17 variant refits; snap never flips; the FE-6 care+unemp pair never flips. Three columns CAN flip: median_home_value (Detroit drop), cage (St. Louis drop), bookings (St. Louis drop) — the banked verdict never leans on those three. Selection bias is BOUNDED, not eliminated: the panel's fragile columns are its non-headline columns.

step4_power_curve.question: When should expansion stop — more rows, or deeper rows?
step4_power_curve.verdict: DEEPEN FIRST — the SE-shrink curve kinks near n≈150 (SE ~0.35-0.49x today's) and flattens by n≈250 (~0.27-0.38x); n=400 buys only another ~0.06-0.09x — expansion past ~150 city-years stops materially moving t-stats; DEEPENING (more years per existing city + more lanes per city) buys the same sqrt(n) without new fixed-effect intercepts AND without a new honest-null surface
step4_power_curve.plain_english: The between-city share of murder variance is 53%-87% depending on frame — and fixed effects ABSORB that share without explaining it. Every new city adds an intercept (dof cost) and a new honest-null surface, while the between-city variance it contributes is eaten, not used. The t+1 arc frame (the banked headline instrument) is the exception: it has a 47% within share, so new cities DO add learning there. Recommendation registered: deepen to ~150 city-years (the sqrt-knee), expand ONLY in the t+1 arc class where the 47% within-share says new cities teach, and expand one NEW-LANE per city (education/bookings arcs) rather than more cities at the same lanes.

step5_panel_churn.question: How much history exists only because a city kept publishing?
step5_panel_churn.verdict: 0.832 CARRY — 116 of 663 banked-window city-years are drop events; the panel exists on a 83% retention base, and the five longest surviving runs (NYC 46, STL 28, CIN 12, DET 14-span, MEM 6) are 100% retained while BOSTON/NOLA/HOUSTON carry 33-63% drops

headline.read: of every city-year that EXISTS in the banked windows, this fraction survived to a banked cell; the rest are drop events (publication stops, month-guards, format breaks) — the panel's history exists only where a city kept publishing through all of these.

step5_panel_churn.plain_english: Every banked window implies history that a publication gap erased: Boston lost 33 of 46 interior years (crack-era silence), New Orleans 22 of 35 (including the 0/12-months 2025 pass-through year), Houston 13 of 22, St. Louis 7 straight (2003-2009), Detroit 3, Raleigh 4 after its 5/12-months year. Jacksonville's bookings lane is defined by the ten-year 0/12 hole. The survivorship law: the panel's 100%-retained runs (NYC 46-year, St. Louis 28-year, Cincinnati 12-year) are runs of CITIES THAT KEPT PUBLISHING — the survivorship is real but it is CITY-LEVEL publication, not outcome-selection: no panel city's murder arc was dropped for being high or low; drops are publication-class or format-class only. The models' history exists only because those six cities' ledgers never went dark in their window.

preregistration.city: Louisville KY (Louisville Metro Police Department, Census place 48006 / agency ORI KY0568000)
preregistration.registered_by: hermes pre-expansion-gauntlet child run (step 6), workspace build/
preregistration.prediction: DOWN — Louisville's 2026 murder rate finishes BELOW its own 2021-2025 mean of 30.69 per-100k
preregistration.prediction_class: direction-only (the banked within-city convention: hit iff sign(2026 rate − 2021-25 mean) == DOWN). NO level forecast claimed — the full-read magnitude (−32.5 rate-pts) is OUT-OF-SUPPORT and voided, see laws.
preregistration.falsifier: LMPD full-year 2026 homicide count published on the keyless FBI CDE summarizer (cde.ucr.cjis.gov/LATEST/summarized/agency/KY0568000/HOM, refreshes ~Mar-2027) or the LMPD year-end report; convert rate = count / CDE agency-jurisdiction pop × 1e5. The call is FALSIFIED iff sign(2026 rate − 30.69) != negative (i.e. the rate finishes at-or-above 30.69). Unresolvable if the 0/12-months non-reporting class recurs (the Jacksonville 2011-2020 banked pattern) — in that case the call is void, not scored.

step6_preregistered_civic_call.city_choice_reasoning: Jacksonville carries the banked ten-year 0/12 non-reporting run (the no-2024-bookings class) — its murders lane is exactly the failure class this gauntlet audits; Louisville publishes full monthly actuals + population through the same keyless route with zero gaps 2013-2025
step6_preregistered_civic_call.plain_english: Louisville was picked because BOTH its lanes answered without a key: the FBG CDE summarizer returns LMPD's full monthly actuals (2013-2025, zero gaps — against Jacksonville's ten-year silence) and its agency population block; the ACS strata came through the same keyless www2 route the panel is built on. The call: Louisville's 2026 rate finishes BELOW its own 2021-25 mean of 30.69. The honest full-read magnitude is out-of-support (Louisville's strata sit 18-21 SD off the 5-city panel frame) so the magnitude is VOIDED and only the direction is registered — with the falsifier, the timestamp, and a daily 10am re-check wired to the cron.

six_verdicts_summary: 1 HOLD-OUT: GATE-OPEN — t+1 arc LOCO 0.75-1.00 (mean 0.812); drift-check reproduces the banked 0.938 exactly; arc instrument survives its own blindfolds, level-transfer and FE-2 book no such claims
2 RESIDUAL-STICK: STICKS (WEAK) — pooled lag-1 r 0.459 > 0.3 threshold; arcs carry the signal, single next-year reads do not (1/4 sign-holds 2022->2023)
3 COMPOSITION-BIAS: HOLD, BOUNDED — founder-carrying signs (care-, snap+, FE-6 pair) never flip across 17 drop-refits; home/cage/bookings flips named and they are non-headline columns
4 POWER-CURVE: DEEPEN — kink near n=150, flat by 250; between-city share (53-87%) is absorbed by FE, deepening buys sqrt(n) without new intercepts; expand only in the t+1 arc class (47% within share)
5 PANEL-CHURN: 0.832 CARRY — 116/663 window city-years are drop events; retained runs = cities that never went dark; survivorship is publication-class, not outcome-selection
6 CIVIC CALL: REGISTERED — Louisville DOWN vs own 2021-25 mean 30.69; magnitude voided (out-of-support); falsifier + timestamp + 10am cron live
